description: This file defines the AttendanceService class which manages attendance records, configurations, and permissions within the OrangeHRM human resource management system, specifically for attendance-related functionalities such as punch records, overlapping checks, timezone conversions, and workflow authorization.

classes.name: AttendanceService
classes.description: A service class providing core functionality to manage attendance records, permissions, configurations, and time zone conversions within the HRM system.

methods.name: getAccessFlowStateMachineService
methods.description: Retrieves or instantiates the AccessFlowStateMachineService used for workflow state management.

methods.name: getAttendanceDao
methods.description: Returns the AttendanceDao object, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: setAttendanceDao
methods.description: Sets the AttendanceDao object.

methods.name: canUserChangeCurrentTime
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to change the current time.

methods.name: savePunchRecord
methods.description: Saves an attendance punch record.

methods.name: checkForPunchOutOverLappingRecords
methods.description: Checks for overlapping punch-out records for an employee.

methods.name: checkForPunchInOverLappingRecords
methods.description: Checks for overlapping punch-in records for an employee.

methods.name: getAttendanceRecord
methods.description: Retrieves attendance records for an employee on a specific date.

methods.name: deleteAttendanceRecords
methods.description: Deletes an attendance record by ID.

methods.name: getAttendanceRecordById
methods.description: Fetches an attendance record by its ID.

methods.name: getTimezone
methods.description: Returns the timezone offset string for a given value.

methods.name: getTimezoneArray
methods.description: Provides an array mapping timezone offset indices to timezone strings.

methods.name: getLocalTimezone
methods.description: Returns the timezone region name corresponding to a client timezone offset.

methods.name: checkForPunchInOverLappingRecordsWhenEditing
methods.description: Checks for overlap of punch-in records during editing, given a record ID.

methods.name: checkForPunchOutOverLappingRecordsWhenEditing
methods.description: Checks for overlap of punch-out records during editing, given a record ID.

methods.name: checkForPunchInOutOverLappingRecordsWhenEditing
methods.description: Check for overlapping punch-in/out during editing, given a record ID.

methods.name: searchAttendanceRecords
methods.description: Searches for attendance records based on various criteria.

methods.name: getLatestPunchInRecord
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent punch-in record for an employee based on a specified state.

methods.name: getPunchTimeUserConfiguration
methods.description: Checks if the user is allowed to edit punch times based on configuration.

methods.name: getAttendanceRecordsBetweenTwoDays
methods.description: Fetches attendance records of an employee within a date range.

methods.name: getAttendanceRecordsByEmpNumbers
methods.description: Retrieves attendance records for multiple employees given their employee numbers.

methods.name: canUserChangeCurrentTimeConfiguration
methods.description: Determines if the user is permitted to modify the current time configuration.

methods.name: canUserModifyAttendanceConfiguration
methods.description: Checks if the user can modify attendance records.

methods.name: canSupervisorModifyAttendanceConfiguration
methods.description: Checks if a supervisor can modify attendance records.

methods.name: enableUserCanChangeCurrentTimeConfiguration
methods.description: Enables user permissions to change current time by saving configurations.

methods.name: disableUserCanChangeCurrentTimeConfiguration
methods.description: Disables user permissions to change current time by removing workflow records.

methods.name: enableUserCanModifyAttendanceConfiguration
methods.description: Allows user modifications to attendance configuration by saving necessary permissions.

methods.name: disableUserCanModifyAttendanceConfiguration
methods.description: Revokes user modification permissions by deleting workflow records.

methods.name: enableSupervisorCanModifyAttendanceConfiguration
methods.description: Grants supervisor permission to modify attendance configurations.

methods.name: disableSupervisorCanModifyAttendanceConfiguration
methods.description: Revokes supervisor permissions to modify attendance configurations.

methods.name: saveConfiguration
methods.description: Saves a workflow configuration record with specified parameters.

methods.name: isAuthUserAllowedToPerformTheEditActions
methods.description: Checks if the authenticated user has permission to perform edit actions on an attendance record.
